# Cambridge Dictionary

> > Cambridge Dictionary provides authoritative bilingual translations, definitions, and language reference resources from Cambridge University Press.

The dictionary draws from extensive corpora including the Cambridge English Corpus, Europarl Parallel Corpus, and Hansard, offering translations between English and French with real-world usage examples. Premium features are available through Cambridge Dictionary +Plus for enhanced vocabulary learning.

## Key Topics

- English-French translation
- Bilingual dictionary
- Cambridge English Corpus
- PASSWORD English-French Dictionary
- GLOBAL English-French Dictionary
- Europarl Parallel Corpus
- Word definitions
- Vocabulary reference
- Language learning
- Cambridge University Press
- Multilingual translations
- Usage examples
- Grammar reference
- Cambridge Dictionary +Plus

## Premium Features

- [Cambridge Dictionary +Plus](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/plus): Premium features: quizzes, word lists, and vocabulary games

## English-French Translation Reference

- [A | translate English to French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/a): English-French translation for indefinite article 'a' with grammar
- [ABANDONED in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/abandoned): English-French translation for 'abandoned' with multiple meanings
- [ABDUCT | translate English to French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/abduct): English-French verb translation for 'abduct' from GLOBAL Dictionary
- [ABSENTEEISM in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/absenteeism): English-French translation for 'absenteeism' with corpus examples
- [ABSORBING in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/absorbing): English-French translation for 'absorbing' with PASSWORD Dictionary
- [ACCESSIBLE in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/accessible): English-French translation for 'accessible' with Europarl examples
- [ACCESS CODE in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/access-code): English-French computing term translation for 'access code'
- [ACCORDING TO in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/according-to): English-French preposition translation for 'according to'
- [ACCUSING in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/accusing): English-French adjective translation for 'accusing'
- [ACIDITY | translate English to French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/acidity): English-French translation for 'acidity' from PASSWORD Dictionary
- [ACNE | translate English to French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/acne): English-French medical term translation for 'acne'
- [AD-LIB | translate English to French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/ad-lib): English-French translation for 'ad-lib' with usage examples
- [ADHERENT in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/adherent): English-French translation for 'adherent' with usage examples
- [ADVISER | translate English to French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/adviser): English-French translation for 'adviser' from GLOBAL Dictionary
- [ADVISORY in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/advisory): English-French translation for 'advisory' with Europarl corpus
